guidelines.introStyle: Standard spoken intro: present focus → 1–2 experience anchors from the résumé → why this company/role. Keep it simple; do not cram every bullet.
guidelines.reuse: Behavioral STAR answers may reuse the same expanded point when it fits. Very general answers (intro, AI workflow, asking for help / admitting mistakes) should each have a distinct angle even if they share an anchorPointId.
guidelines.starNote: Use Context–Task–Action–Result for behavioral stories. Not every bank item needs a unique product story.

required.question: Why this company / why this role?
How are you incorporating AI into your current workflow?
required.eraNote: Emphasize for candidates with 2024+ experience; otherwise answer honestly about limited or no use.

required.question: When do you ask teammates for suggestions, and how do you communicate when you made a mistake?
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate or stakeholder.
Tell me about a time something went wrong and how you handled it.
Tell me about a project you are proud of.
Tell me about a time you had to solve an ambiguous problem.
